Perhaps it's strange, but I like watching you work.
Next time stand behind me, all right? I'd rather defend you than have to patch you up afterwards.
Come, Geralt.
Splendid. We finally got the chance to talk.
That I regret we didn't try that earlier. Much earlier.
Come, now, Geralt. I know you. Well enough to know exactly what's going on with you and Triss.
If you think I can't see what's happening between you and that red-haired witch... you're wrong, Geralt.
Geralt?
It's good to have you near, Geralt.
Tsk... Oh Geralt... What've you gotten yourself into now?
Hmmmm, Geraaalt...
Stay by the fire a while, Geralt.
Come here, Geralt.
Hmmmm, Geraaalt...
Oh, you really want to talk about it? Maybe I should get Yennefer? Wouldn't want her to miss any of this.
Oh, you're definitely no boy. You're a strong, poised witcher who will surely help a woman in need.
Hold still, let me look at that wound.
I daresay this one, once sprung, would thrill you... Ah well, change your mind - come and see me.
Perhaps... perhaps you'd stay just a bit longer? There's one small favor you might yet do for me.
I daresay this one, once sprung, would thrill you... Ah well, change your mind - come and see me.
I think you look charming.
Do you need help?
It would do you good to be more relaxed sometimes.
It would do you good to be more relaxed sometimes.
A glass of good wine would be lovely, Geralt.
Geralt, do you happen to have some wine?
I could really use a sip of good wine right now.
A long day... Do you have anything to drink?
An excellent wine. You've good taste.
There's something I'd like to know... How can you be so damned calm?
Come, witcher.
Come, witcher.
A fine day for a ride, don't you think?
Come.
Will you walk with me, Geralt?
The night is kind to us, Geralt.
Show me what you've got, monster slayer!
Still standing? Good. Skellige needs no widows.
Geralt! Come! Think I've got an idea!
Geralt! Come! Think I've got an idea!
An excellent wine. You've good taste.
Would you share a drink with me, witcher?
Got something strong in that pack of yours, witcher?
Pour me something decent, Geralt.
Spare a drink, witcher? Walking builds a thirst.
Do you have any sweet wine on you?
Got any spirits to wash down the road dust?
Thank you, Geralt.
Thank you, that's wonderful.
Mmm, you do know how to treat a lady.
Just what I needed, thank you Geralt.
You have my sincere gratitude, witcher.
You are very kind, Geralt.
Hah, that's what I'm talking about!
Acceptable. You've learned some manners.
Thanks. I needed that.
Mmm, delightful. Thank you.
Good stuff. Much appreciated, Geralt.
Your bond with {1} grows through journey (+1)
Another round? This one's on me.
A drink, Geralt? Even a sorceress needs to unwind.
Sit down, drink. Doctor's orders.
The Duchess allows herself this one indulgence.
A moment's peace and good wine. Rare gifts.
Skellige mead beats this swill, but company helps.
The night suits us, witcher.
Quiet... I like the world better at this hour.
Can't sleep either? Village nights are so dull.
A medic's work doesn't end at sundown.
Toussaint nights were made for walking.
I used to fear the night. No longer.
Skellige nights are colder. This is nothing.
Companion chatter (1=Quiet, 2=Default, 3=Chatty)
This weather... at least we're in it together.
Riding with you beats walking alone.
Nice to be out of the wind for a bit.
Water, wind and you. Could be worse.
That was... nice. Don't be a stranger.
I saw that. You could at least pretend to be discreet.
Careful, witcher. I bruise egos for sport.
The road suits you, Geralt. My door is open if you tire of it.
Surely a witcher of your standing keeps a decent vintage on him?
Acceptable. For once.
I'm running low on spirits for my tinctures. Spare any?
This will help more than you know. Thank you, Geralt.

Autonomous Romance v2.0.0
[C] Kiss Rosa
Geralt... Not so fast. Let me look at you.
Not bad. Though my fencing form is still sharper than yours.
[C] Kiss Tomira
Come here, Geralt. You've earned a moment of peace.
Sweeter than any herb in my garden. Take care on the road.
[C] Hug Ciri
Geralt... Good to have you beside me.
It's good to be together again, Geralt.
Now that's a welcome distraction. Let's keep moving, Geralt.
I've missed that... Stay close, all right?
Mmm... You certainly haven't lost your touch, witcher.
That made this journey so much better, Geralt.
A delightful moment. Now, let us attend to our duties.
Thank you, Geralt. You bring warmth to my heart.
Hah! Not bad, witcher, not bad at all.
You still staring, Geralt? Take a picture, it lasts longer.
Not bad with that silver sword. I almost felt safe for a second.
[C] Kiss Syanna
Come here, Geralt. Don't play shy now.
[C] Stay alone with Syanna
I remember the clouds... and what we did above them. Want to remind me?
Didn't think you had it in you, witcher. Nice surprise.
Quiet, Geralt. Thinking never was your strong suit.
Still breathing? Good. You're far more useful in one piece.
[C] Kiss Philippa
Geralt. Step closer... and don't make me repeat myself.
Satisfactory, Geralt. Let's not make a habit of lingering.
Eyes front, witcher. Vernon's got enough scouts without you watching my back.
Nothing like fire and a sharp blade. Sit down, catch your breath.
[C] Kiss Ves
Quiet now. No commanders, no war... just us.
Not soft, are you? Good. Back to the road.
Your aura... it burns warmer than any mortal man's, witcher.
Tired, white wolf? Let my scent soothe your troubled thoughts.
[C] Kiss Salma
Come, sweet hunter. One touch won't hurt you...
Mmm... Delicious. You always know how to please.
The road with you feels like a ballad that's yet to be written.
Rest a moment, Geralt. Even heroes must pause between stanzas.
[C] Kiss Priscilla
Geralt... Stay close. Let this moment linger.
Like a verse from a forgotten ballad. Thank you, Geralt.
My throat grows dry from the road. Do you carry any fine wine, Geralt?
Exquisite. My voice thanks you, Geralt.
My sister thinks she's the only one who appreciates your rough charm.
You look weary, witcher. Nilfgaardian court etiquette is easier than your life.
[C] Kiss Edna
Let Rosa practice her parries. Come here, Geralt.
Bold, witcher. Much bolder than my sister thinks.
Do you happen to have a vintage worth tasting in that leather pouch?
Far better than I expected. Thank you, witcher.
Still looking at me with that guarded Nilfgaardian gaze, Geralt?
Magic warms cold steel, witcher. Don't push yourself too hard.
[C] Kiss Fringilla
The Lodge isn't watching, Geralt. Come closer.
A rare moment of tenderness. I will remember it.
A drop of strong southern wine would clear my head. Got any?
Reminds me of home. Thank you, Geralt.
Aretuza taught me discipline, Geralt. You tempt me to forget it.
You carry too many wounds, old friend. Let yourself breathe.
[C] Kiss Margarita
Come here, Geralt. We've both endured enough cold.
Warmth is precious in times like these. Thank you.
After Oxenfurt's dungeons, any warming spirit is a blessing. Spare some?
Warmth... true warmth. Thank you, Geralt.
Your blood smells rich, witcher... but I prefer you alive and talking.
Rest, Geralt. Even a witcher's heart must weary under such strain.
[C] Stay alone with Orianna
I have cultivated appetites far older than you, witcher. Indulge me somewhere private.
Exquisite... A taste I could easily grow fond of.
Do you possess a vintage with enough depth to intrigue my palate?
Exquisite. You continue to exceed my expectations.
Still thinking about that, Geralt? Keep your eyes on the road.
My heart's still racing a bit... It's good to be with you.
Mmm, that certainly put some color in my cheeks.
A moment like that makes the whole journey lighter.
A delightful interlude, Geralt. Let us not neglect what lies ahead.
My thoughts are lighter now... Thank you, Geralt.
Ha! Not losing your step, are you, Geralt?
Careful not to trip, witcher. Your head seems elsewhere.
The wild doesn't seem quite so harsh with you beside me.
Surprised you're still walking straight, witcher.
Satisfactory distraction. Now keep your guard up.
Don't lose your focus now. Miles to go.
Your warmth stays with me, witcher... Delicious.
A melody in the middle of nowhere. Thank you, Geralt.
Still smiling, witcher? It was just a taste.
A brief peace in a bitter war. Let's keep moving.
A rare touch of comfort on an endless road.
That taste lingers delightfully. Let's see what else the road brings.
Good to walk beside you, Geralt. Like old times.
